headline: The shop says Monday by appointment. Yellow Pages still closes Saturday at 1.
summary: This is a real family upholstery shop at 2235 Fletcher Parkway, open since 1960. Julian already shows up in the reviews. Yelp is claimed, 5.0 from about 62 notes. The phone is (619) 469-3460. The Contact page this week prints BaronetUpholstery@gmail.com and Tuesday through Saturday 8:30 to 4:30, Monday by appointment. Yelp prints Monday closed and Saturday 8:30 to 4:30. Unilocal and Yellow Pages print Monday 8:30 to 4:30 and Saturday 9 to 1. Birdeye prints Monday 9 to 6 and Saturday closed. A neighbor with a torn cushion can show up Monday to a locked door, or Saturday at 2:00 to a shop that is still staffed, or already locked.
